Synopsis:
The Trump administration escalated economic pressure on Iran via 36 new sanctions targeting Iran's entire aviation sector under "Operation Economic Outcast." Treasury designated 27 Iranian airlines, front companies in Turkey, UAE, and Malaysia, and suspended aviation authorizations. The action aims to ground Mahan Air and cut off Iran's access to US-origin aircraft and technology. Foreign intermediaries globally are warned they risk exclusion from the global financial system. This is part of a broader campaign including a naval blockade and oil export restrictions to squeeze Iran's economy and pressure Tehran over the Strait of Hormuz.
